title: Ops worklist export
description: The versioned ops-worklist metrics contract F1 emits per reconciliation run and F5 (control room) consumes. F2 (disputes) conforms to the same shape. Amounts are counts, not money; every number is engine-computed.

schema_version.description: Pins the contract. F5's drift guard requires this exact value.

feed_id.description: The feed pairing this worklist belongs to.

as_of.description: The explicit instant the run was computed against (ISO 8601 date).

queue_depth.description: Number of unreconciled breaks in the worklist.

throughput.description: Number of groups the matcher reconciled this run.

aging_buckets.description: Break counts by age band in days. Bands are inclusive of their upper bound; d8_plus is open-ended.

sla_clock_state.description: How many breaks have breached the aging SLA versus remain within it, plus the threshold used.
